title: exudyn.cUtilities: the kinematics functions of rigidBodyUtilities in C++
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG11.10.4: the functions approved in RG11.10.1, bound from RigidBodyMath.h, the missing ones written there; a test compares them with the Python implementation to 1-2 ULP.
releaseNotes: New submodule exudyn.cUtilities: the kinematics functions of rigid bodies in C++ (rotation matrices, Euler parameters, Tait-Bryan and zyz angles, rotation vectors, ExpSO3, LogSO3, skew matrices, basis vectors), the same bits on every platform (revision2026c step RG11.10.4)
